Perfect! 

## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4004. The issue was that the smtp-relay service was moved from the notify namespace to the shared-infra namespace on Sunday night, but the notification-worker application was still configured to use the short hostname `smtp-relay`. This caused DNS resolution failures since short hostnames only resolve within the same namespace. The fix is to update the notification-worker's `SMTP_HOST` configuration from `smtp-relay` to the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local`, which allows cross-namespace service access as documented in the Kubernetes DNS documentation.
